lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid. Posterior to the dorsal fin, the centroids align into discrete horizontal rows extending toward the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible checkerboard grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple linear features running horizontally along the flank are visible, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge.
